verdict.rationale: The only built-in assistant in the evidence is ClickStack AI Notebooks, where you describe an issue in plain language and an AI agent queries logs, traces and metrics for you, returning charts and summaries. It is offered only via a waitlist and is limited to observability data. The MCP server and agent skills connect external assistants to ClickHouse rather than providing one inside the product, so they don't count here. Missing for 10: a generally available in-product assistant, task delegation beyond ClickStack observability (e.g. general SQL/database work in Cloud), in-depth docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
